release.content: pubtest 0.4.0 was released on 2026-11-20 from commit e6d427d48189f2c6e58db9e3bdc35ba0bb0b4e57 with these changes.

rows: pubtest's Python distribution is pubtestrules, its PyPI name (PyPI's pubtest is another project): the wheel is pubtestrules-X-py3-none-any.whl and is uploaded to PyPI as well as attached to the release; `import pubtest`, the pubtest command and the pytest plugin keep their names
the pubtest[integrations] extra: PyPI takes no dependency by URL, and the harness needs only integrations installed, which a recording suite pins itself
